clean_description: A Picture of Dorian Gray tells the story of a young man, Dorian Gray, who becomes enamored with his own portrait and makes a Faustian bargain to remain eternally youthful and beautiful. As he indulges in a life of hedonism and moral decay, only his portrait reveals the consequences of his actions, reflecting the corruption of his soul. The novel critiques the superficiality and moral hypocrisy of Victorian society.
